say.en: At the centre is Saheb, a young ragpicker whose name means lord of the universe.

explanation.en: Seemapuri is close to Delhi in distance but far from it in comfort.

body.en: Saheb is a young ragpicker whose family came from Dhaka in Bangladesh after storms swept away their fields and homes. They live in Seemapuri, a settlement on the edge of Delhi that is close to the city in distance but far from it in comfort. Thousands of ragpickers live there in mud houses with tin and tarpaulin roofs, without proper sewage, drainage or running water. His full name, Saheb-e-Alam, means lord of the universe, which is painfully ironic for a barefoot boy.
